address: Friedberger Landstraße 62, Frankfurt on the Main, 60316, Germany
bio: L'Ecume means foam and makes reference to the lightness of the cuisine here as well as to French chef Alexandre Sadowczyk's native region of Champagne and its famous sparkling wine. In a friendly, casual atmosphere, diners tuck into modern French dishes that incorporate regional accents. The length of the set menu is variable....
